summary: Installer clears previous RAID/LVM/partition signatures from only the selected disk before partitioning, so a reused disk no longer fails with 'No root file system' (BUG-0413); View log includes /var/log/partman. Bumps the working version to 0.4.2. API impact: none.

guide.reason: The install guide now says a previously used disk is cleared (including RAID membership, with other members left unwritten and degraded), lists /var/log/partman in View log, and covers the 'No root file system' error.

api.reason: Installer-local partitioning behavior only; no Controller or Core contract is involved.

roadmap.reason: Installer defect fix within existing scope.

state.reason: Adds no durable product state; the installer marker lives only in the installer's /run.
